title: Emotional Intelligence for Arts Administrators: Collaboration and Teamwork
description: This course is designed to expand the competencies of students in order to work successfully in teams and build true collaborations. Through structured and unstructured team building, students will analyze and evaluate their own experiences in both leading and participating in teams. Special consideration will be placed on the how teams function within arts organizations.
prerequisites: Major status in Arts Administration. AAD 203 and AAD 300
